name: Gallup (United States)
description: Teal blue field charged with the city logo, a white thunderbird in a ring of white dots.
history: Gallup is a city in McKinley County, New Mexico, on the edge of the Navajo Nation. The flag carries the city's thunderbird logo; Flags of the World records that the city council adopted a revised, easily reproducible version of the traditional logo in 2012.

features.role: thunderbird logo in a ring of dots
